features: Versioned feature schema with explicit normalized-feature bin boundaries and schema fingerprint
Role-bound binned abstract states; identifiers are deterministic and truth/oracle feature names are rejected
Immutable option transition records with stable hashes, outcomes, durations, reward components, interventions, fidelity, scenario, opponent, seed, and provenance
Explicit complete/censored/truncated labels; censored records cannot fabricate outcomes, next states, or Bellman targets
Independent map/opponent/seed bank split assignments with cross-dimension, duplicate, and episode leakage checks
Deterministic JSONL record export and manifest serialization with schema, split, provenance, and content hashes
Separate structural contract validity from promotion eligibility; quality review is explicitly pending
Immutable positive Dirichlet prior/count rows with registered success and failure/cancellation outcomes
Posterior mean and variance with uint64 count bounds
Analytic integration of piecewise-constant reward rates under continuous-time exponential discount
Terminal impulse discounting and nonterminal SMDP max-option bootstrap
Explicit eta in (0,1] with schedule identifier; eta is not a physical rate or Dirichlet concentration
Censored/truncated transitions rejected for completed-option returns and Bellman updates
Fusion accepted only for exact declared models matching expected discounted rewards, successor kernels, and option availability; empirical estimates cannot certify exact fusion
